name: metricbraid
description: Multi-device health data routing for Claude Code — reconcile Oura and Garmin without double-counting, averaging, or overclaiming.

plugins.name: metricbraid
plugins.description: Wires up Garmin + Oura MCP servers and installs a capability-based routing model that decides which device wins for which metric, deduplicates overlapping events, and forces the assistant to carry provenance and flag provisional evidence.
